scope: Corrected adapter boundary, HistoryApplication new read methods, factual personal memory and migration/report distinctions. No broad test suite executed by this review.

findings.rootCause: Array.prototype.some skips sparse holes; checking length alone does not establish 21 finite pinned values.
findings.fix: Require Array.isArray and length21, capture indexed values exactly once with Array.from({length:21},(_,index)=>weights[index]), then validate finite values and pin equality on that same frozen capture.

postFixProbe.input: valid indexed weights with custom empty Symbol.iterator
postFixProbe.interpretation: The final bounded indexed capture ignores caller iteration and uses the actual pinned indexed values.

findings.regressionTest: E1A08 in src/core/fsrs-reference.test.ts; final run status belongs to the final suite evidence, not this read-only review.
